premise:
Adapt the exact source episode below into TWO scenes in the selected medium. This is a retelling, NOT a continuation after its ending. Preserve events, causal order, token and transmission expenditure, sibling identity, witness knowledge and the unresolved culprit. Invent only performable/drawable connective texture. Scene 1 ends with departure; scene 2 ends at the council landing. No new climax that changes source events.

AUTHOR SOURCE (authoritative):
At 18:00 Mara and Ivo Venn waited on the ferry quay. They were siblings. Mara held two single-use crossing tokens. Ivo's radio could send two more transmissions. Sera Holt arrived on foot from the archive after a ten-minute walk. She alone knew that the relief ledger's date had been erased.

Sera showed the ledger to both siblings and pointed at the erased date. Ivo transmitted its page number to the archive desk. One outbound transmission remained. Mara surrendered one token and took Sera across the harbor. Ivo remained on the quay. Mara had one token left.

At 18:20 Mara and Sera reached the council landing. Sera kept the ledger. She refused to accuse anyone until they could compare the original receipt. The erased date was evidence of alteration, not proof of who altered it. Ivo had not seen the council landing or heard this refusal.

length_policy.policy: 2 connected scenes, target 300 words each; at least 240. Longer natural scenes are advisory. No filler or repeated discoveries.

world_rules: Only this brief and accepted on-page events are canon.
Private beliefs and clues cannot leak without an enacted disclosure.
Mara and Ivo remain siblings, with stable names and identities.
Every token or radio transmission is counted at its actual expenditure.
Physical travel, entrances and exits need an explicit cause and interval.
No retroactive backup power, extra token, secret tunnel or unearned rescue.
Plans, suspicions and hypotheses are not completed history.
Any extraordinary mechanism must be established with limits before solving a conflict.
Different medium presentation never changes underlying facts.
Costs, injuries, custody and consequences persist.
A twist needs an observable setup before payoff; no new retrospective facts to explain it.
Only the current scene participants may act unless a new entrance is established.
The supplied AUTHOR SOURCE is the exact event contract; preserve its ending and uncertainty.

Mara holds exactly two single-use ferry passage tokens. Each token permits one ferry crossing; spent tokens cannot return.
Ivo holds one portable radio with power for two outbound transmissions; receiving uses no counted transmission.
Mara and Ivo are siblings; neither has told the other their private household promise.
